learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how to measure the length, width, and height of different things using rulers and tapes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: For small objects like pencils, erasers, or your little finger, we use centimeters. Look at your geometry scale, the small lines are cm!
For tall and long things like the height of a door, the length of your classroom, or cloth, we use meters. One meter is very long, it has 100 centimeters inside it!
Before using a scale, we can play a guessing game! Look at an object and estimate how long it is, then measure it to see if you were right.

fun_activity.title: 📏 Hand Span vs Ruler
fun_activity.instructions: Measure the length of your study table using your hand spans first. Then, ask an elder to help you measure it exactly using a measuring tape!

quick_recap: ⭐ We measure the length to find out how long or tall an object is.
⭐ Centimeters (cm) are used for short things, and Meters (m) are used for long things.
⭐ 100 centimeters joined together make 1 whole meter!
